title: Shipping Policy
content: Orders are delivered within 2-5 business days across Egypt.

title: Return Policy
content: Customers can return products within 14 days of receiving the order, provided the items are unused, in their original condition, and with all tags attached.

title: Exchange Policy
content: Customers can exchange products within 14 days for a different size or color, subject to stock availability.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept Cash on Delivery, Visa, MasterCard, and Vodafone Cash.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after the returned item passes inspection.

title: Order Cancellation
content: Orders can be canceled before they are shipped. Once shipped, customers must follow the return policy.

title: Size Guide
content: Every product page includes a size chart to help customers choose the correct size.

title: Customer Support
content: Customer support is available daily from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
